gen-gf-grandstander-gf-heebo: Expressive and loud, Grandstander draws every stroke at a constant width with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Heebo follows in sans-serif form, its curves stopping short of closing, so the heading gets all the attention.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-guntur: Chunky, open-mouthed letters up top from Grandstander, then Hind Guntur underneath with tall lowercase forms and no thick-thin shift. Give that plain sans a little extra size.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads friendly and sturdy, its lowercase filling the line almost like capitals, with s curves opening wide at both ends. Then Grandstander steps in over it with bold, expressive strokes and short ascenders.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru reads crisp and upright, with lowercase tops pressed close to the ascender line. Its strongest quality is how that tidy plain sans sits under Grandstander, whose bold, constant-width strokes and held-open shapes carry all the swagger.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri hums along in a flat, constant line weight. Grandstander is the one to make noise with its bold, expressive display letters, while the plain sans body keeps rounds slightly gapped and approachable.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hind-vadodara: Loud letters, quiet partner. Hind Vadodara brings a clean sans with spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs and tall bowls, and that openness echoes Grandstander's own held-open, constant-width strokes, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-huninn: Grandstander's short ascenders and tall x-height give its bold, expressive shapes a stocky, friendly swagger. And Huninn matches that height with sans-serif lowercase rising close to cap height, which gives the pair its real strength: a shared tall, sturdy look.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-inter-tight: Bold, bouncy and tall-bodied up top. Inter Tight sits underneath like bent tubing, with short ascenders and curve tails held well back, so it feels tidy and restrained next to Grandstander's loud personality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-karla: Grandstander lays down bold, expressive letters with uninterrupted line width on every character, short ascenders and a tall x-height. Karla's gaping c and stocky sans-serif middle band are the shared sturdiness.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kedebideri: Big, cheerful heading shapes with no swelling where curves meet stems. Kedebideri's skyward x-height and rounded, inviting letters sit under Grandstander's bold strokes like a friendly echo, so the plain sans body feels like part of the same voice.
